facts.fact: The SA SME Fund, the Technology Innovation Agency and impact investor E Squared Investments announced on 1 October 2024 the launch of a R300 million seed fund of funds for tech startups; no private share of the amount is stated.

systems.owner: SA SME Fund, TIA, E Squared Investments
SA SME Fund, TIA, E Squared Investments

ZAF.note: The fund is launched and is yet to allocate capital to managers; no startup is financed, and no startup law or strategy is mentioned.
Nothing on a hub, incubator or park.
